description: React component for a toggleable menu wrapper with animation, handling open/close state, event listeners, and deprecated usage note.

classes.name: MenuWrapper
classes.description: A React component that manages a toggleable menu with animation, handling user interactions and lifecycle events.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component, checks children count, sets initial state, and creates ref.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Adds event listeners if menu is open after mounting.

methods.name: getDerivedStateFromProps
methods.description: Synchronizes internal open state with props.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Adds or removes event listeners based on open state changes.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Removes event listeners if menu is open before unmounting.

methods.name: addEventListeners
methods.description: Adds click and keyup event listeners to document.

methods.name: removeEventListeners
methods.description: Removes click and keyup event listeners from document.

methods.name: keyboardClose
methods.description: Handles ESCAPE and TAB key events to close the menu.

methods.name: closeOnBlur
methods.description: Closes menu if click target is outside the menu node.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Sets open state to false and triggers onToggle callback.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles menu open state, optionally stopping propagation, and triggers onToggle callback.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the menu wrapper div with children and animation component based on state.
